item.title: Probably looking at an Engine Rebuild in the near future. TSP Built Shortblock with 70,000 miles.
item.author: invalid@example.com (Zedaine)
item.dc:creator: Zedaine
item.content:encoded:
So lately I have been getting misfires at WOT above 5000 rpm in 3rd and 4th gear. Car runs perfectly fine otherwise and fuel trims, gas mileage, and overall cruising and moderate acceleration, etc are great.

Replaced the spark plugs and did an oil change a few weeks ago. Checked the plugs again yesterday as well as used a borescope to check...

Probably looking at an Engine Rebuild in the near future. TSP Built Shortblock with 70,000 miles.

item.title: What TPMS system do you use?
item.author: invalid@example.com (FK7Boi)
item.dc:creator: FK7Boi
item.content:encoded:
Honda is innovative in some ways and behind the times in others. While virtually every other automaker has a built-in tire pressure monitoring system which displays the PSI in real time on the dash, it still hasn’t occurred to Honda to implement what is arguably one of the most important metrics on a road conveyance. Perhaps they did it to save on cost, but I would’ve gladly paid the extra few hundred for this system. No/low air—you’re not going anywhere and risk damaging other conponents...

item.title: How is your tune working on track?
item.author: invalid@example.com (Dave B)
item.dc:creator: Dave B
item.content:encoded:
I was so upset recently after Honda stopped the LogR app and really wanted to have some real gauges, (at least a real ECT one) so I ended up buying a Cobb Accessport. I have always stayed away from a tune to help with keeping the whole car cool whether it be ECT, IAT or oil temps. OTOH, I couldn't resist trying their included 91 octane tune. I found it seemed to behave like they said, i.e. potentialy a bit slower under 3500 but more powerful at higher revs. It seemed that way on the street...

How is your tune working on track?
